selection_policy.status: PROPOSED exploratory point ranking only; not formal implementation/model selection
selection_policy.rule: Report highest observed pooled AP, retaining ties; report per-fold AP and fold mean AP alongside it. No significance, practical-equivalence, deployment or final-model-selection claim.
selection_policy.margin_limitation: Linear SVM has raw margins and threshold 0; pooling uncalibrated fold scores assumes cross-fold comparability. Within-fold AP is additionally reported to expose that limitation.
selection_policy.formal_selection_boundary: Existing select_research_family requires accepted nested calibrated evidence, selection policy and benchmark/SRS decisions. These are not supplied by a fixed uncalibrated comparison and that gate is not bypassed.

checkpoint_policy: One immutable result directory and verified completion marker per completed family. Reruns verify and skip completed families; a partial output without a valid marker stops without overwriting.
